title: Sindiket proses air ketum beroperasi sejak 2 tahun lalu tumpas di Pasir Mas
summary: Pasir Mas: Kegiatan memproses dan menjual air ketum yang dipercayai beroperasi sejak dua tahun lalu terbongkar selepas diserbu Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) di kawasan semak Kampung Belukar, di sini, tengah hari semalam.

title_en: Tobacco water processing syndicate operating since two years ago, dismantled in Pasir Mas
summary_en: Pasir Mas: A process and sale of tobacco water that was believed to have been operating for two years has been uncovered after being raided by the General Operations Group (PGA) in Kampung Belukar bush area, here yesterday at noon.
